text:
selim_acme: hey team — after the rollout last night Turkish users are getting mixed-language replies. Some answers are in English, some include stray Hebrew words. example below (user asked in Turkish).

selim_acme: Prompt: "Hesabımı nasıl silerim?"
Response: "To delete your account, go to Settings > Account. אם אתה צריך עזרה, צור קשר."
request_id: req_0ab12cd34  model: rwd-2.1-medium  route: /v1/generate  time: 2026-03-16T23:58:12Z

selim_acme: Another: Prompt: "Siparişimi iptal edebilir miyim?"
Response: "You can cancel your order from Orders > Cancel. שינוי אפשרי בתנאים."
request_id: req_0ab12cd99  latency_ms: 410

ana_cs: thanks for filing — really sorry about the regression :frowning:  can you confirm whether you send an Accept-Language header or a language param? also any recent change on your side?

selim_acme: we only send Accept-Language: tr, never hebrew or en. no client changes. this started exactly after your 23:40 deploy.

liam_engineering: @ana_cs pinged. selim — can you paste a curl (headers + body) for one failing req? also include the full response JSON if possible (we need model_version/model_hash).

selim_acme: sure — here's a sanitized repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_redacted" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "Accept-Language: tr" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.1-medium","input":"Hesabımı nasıl silerim?","max_tokens":120}'
```
full response (trim):
```
{
  "id":"resp_123","request_id":"req_0ab12cd34","model":"rwd-2.1-medium","model_hash":"abcdeffedcba","output":"To delete your account... אם אתה צריך עזרה..."
}
```

maria_ml: thanks — tagging @liam_engineering. this smells like locale-routing or the ensemble fallback we enabled in the canary. we shipped a change that relaxes language-tag constraints so short prompts can fallback to base english variants. maybe the detection head is over-triggering for Turkish and accidentally mixing in the he locale token embedding.

liam_engineering: good call. i'll check model logs for locale detection scores + fallback decision for req_0ab12cd34 and req_0ab12cd99. can someone from infra confirm which rollout and which canary fraction went live?

opsbot: deploy-bot: rollout rlr-2026-03-16T23:40Z (commit: 1a2b3c4) — features: locale-routing-v2 (canary 30%), model-build rwd-2.1-medium promoted to canary pool. link: https://deploys.internal/rlr-2026-03-16T23:40Z

ana_cs: selim — as temporary mitigation can you pin to rwd-2.0-small via route override? if you want we can flip a per-customer override from our side while we investigate.

selim_acme: we'd prefer you do it from your side if that's fast. our product team is seeing customer churn already.

liam_engineering: oncall will open a P0. i'll fetch logs now. early note: both req ids show locale_score(tr)=0.82 but fallback_to_en flag=true in decision log — odd. also see stray token ids mapping to he_subword_0x3f in kvcache for a few steps.

maria_ml: that points to tokenization/embedding table alignment across variants (v2 routing introduced a merged vocab). i'm rolling back the merged-vocab switch on the canary pool and checking a diff between the token->id maps for tr and he.

opsbot: action: rollback-started for feature locale-routing-v2 on canary pool (ticket: #INC-1729)

ana_cs: i'll let selim know and confirm when override & rollback complete.

selim_acme: thanks. one more datapoint — best-effort reproducible: if prompt length < 10 chars we see english answers more often. longer prompts (20+ chars) tend to be ok. hope that helps.

liam_engineering: super helpful — suggests a short-context detection bug. i'll attach tokenization traces in the ticket.

maria_ml: agreed. will also run our eval suite for tr/he pair to catch regressions.

ana_cs: status update — we've applied a per-customer route override to pin acme to rwd-2.0-small and turned rollback to canary pool on. please confirm if you see immediate improvement.

selim_acme: confirmed — new responses are legit Turkish again, latency similar. huge relief :thumbsup: 

ana_cs: thanks all — we'll keep this thread open until root cause fully validated and change re-released. assigning follow-ups to engineering and ML.

liam_engineering: filed INC-1729 with traces, repro, and rollback notes. next step: validate merged-vocab revert on canary staging, then gradual re-introduction with stricter locale thresholds.

maria_ml: i'll post eval results here when ready.

selim_acme: appreciate the quick response team.
